chunks: Abū ‘Alī Muḥammad ibn Hammām ibn Suhayl narrated to me from Abī ‘Abdillāh Ja‘far ibn Muḥammad ibn Mālik, from al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad al-Abzārī, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Nasr al-Bazanṭī, who said:

I asked Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā (peace be upon him), 'In which month do we visit al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him)?' He replied, 'On the fifteenth of Rajab and the fifteenth of Sha‘bān.' And Aḥmad ibn Hilāl narrated from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Nasr from Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā (peace be upon him) similarly, except that he said, 'Which of the times is best to visit [we visit him] al-Ḥusayn?'
ai.seo_question: When is the best time to visit Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: Imam al-Riḍā (peace be upon him) designates the fifteenth of Rajab and the fifteenth of Sha‘bān as the most virtuous times for visiting Imam al-Ḥusayn (peace be upon him), linking these dates to the broader Shia tradition of commemorating significant events in the Ahl al-Bayt's history. This specific timing underscores the spiritual merit of aligning physical visitation with celestial moments of divine favor, reinforcing the concept of Ziyārah as both a physical act and a spiritual connection to the Imams.
